proposals.title: Stockholder Proposal to Have an Independent Board Chairman
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a policy requiring the Board Chairman to be an independent director whenever possible, including at the next Chairman transition.
proposals.evidence: YOUR BOARD OF DIRECTORS RECOMMENDS A VOTE AGAINST THIS PROPOSAL.

proposals.title: Stockholder Proposal on the Right to Act by Written Consent
proposals.topic_summary: Requests that shareholders be permitted to act by written consent, with the minimum votes needed to authorize action at a fully attended meeting.
proposals.evidence: YOUR BOARD OF DIRECTORS RECOMMENDS A VOTE AGAINST THIS PROPOSAL.

proposals.title: Stockholder Proposal Requesting the Company Publish Annually a Report Assessing its Diversity, Equity and Inclusion Efforts
proposals.topic_summary: Requests an annual report assessing IBM's diversity, equity and inclusion efforts, including the Board's process and assessment of program effectiveness.
proposals.evidence: YOUR BOARD OF DIRECTORS RECOMMENDS A VOTE FOR THIS PROPOSAL.
